instruction: Please configure VS Code to insert spaces instead of tabs when pressing the Tab key.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling insert spaces instead of tabs in VS Code. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify editor.insertSpaces setting equals true. Similar complexity to original task - single setting modification.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts the VS Code settings.json file from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric check_json_settings correctly verifies that editor.insertSpaces is set to true
Expected value is semantically correct - editor.insertSpaces: true is the correct VS Code setting to insert spaces instead of tabs
Complete coverage - the single setting check is sufficient to verify the instruction requirement
No postconfig needed - VS Code settings are persistent and don't depend on UI state
Edge cases handled appropriately - missing file or missing setting returns 0.0
Correct parameter handling for type: rule - metric correctly accesses expected['expected'] to get the settings dict

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
